text: AKGEC publishes semester-wise Academic Calendars (Odd and Even semester, updated each academic year, e.g. Academic Calendar 2026-27 Odd) and an annual List of Holidays (e.g. List of Holidays 2026, 2025, 2023, 2022) as downloadable PDFs on its Academics section. Even semester calendars specify details such as extra working Saturdays for make-up classes (e.g. 14 Feb, 28 Feb, 28 Mar, 11 Apr 2026 in the 2025-26 even semester calendar). The Academics section also links to AKGEC Digital School, the AKTU syllabus portal, Educational Verification procedures, the Policy and Process for Refund of Caution Money, and Issuance of Certificates for passout students.
